title: 좌표(x, y) 정렬
markdown: # 좌표(x, y) 정렬 ## 오름차순 정렬 ```java class Point implements Comparable{ int x, y; Point(int x, int y){ this.x=x; this.y=y; } @Override public int compareTo(Point o){ if(this.x==o.x) return this.y - o.y; else return this.x - o.x; } } Collections.sort([정렬하려는 ArrayList]) ``` ## 내림차순 정렬 ```java class Point implements Comparable{ int x, y; Point(int x, int y){ this.x=x; this.y=y; } @Override public int compareTo(Point o){ if(this.x==o.x) return o.y-this.y; else return o.x-this.x; } } Collections.sort([정렬하려는 ArrayList]) ```
